name: Living With Ghosts
source:
Blossom is a resilient and headstrong young lady, taking care of her family's farm while her father and brothers are out of town pursuing their own dreams. She is at peace with this arrangement – until one Hallow's Eve, when she receives a visit from someone she never got to properly say Goodbye to, and the walls that she has built around her heart are torn open.

[From [url=https://ladyicepaw.itch.io/ghosts]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
布洛瑟姆是一位坚韧而任性的年轻女士，她负责打理家里的农场，而她的父亲和兄弟则出城追求自己的梦想。她对这种安排很平静——直到一个万圣节前夕，当她收到一个她从未好好告别的人来访时，她在内心筑起的围墙被撕开了。

[来自[url=https://ladyicepaw.itch.io/ghosts]itch.io[/url]]
